thread:
jamie: Quick heads-up — planning to flip ~30% traffic to v2 split-route in us-west at :30 (30m). Monitoring: latency, 5xx, client schema mismatch. If any client pins, we should hold.
ash: thanks. which header signals v2?
jamie: X-API-Version: 2 or client-signal=v2. legacy clients send X-API-Version: 1.
oliver: ops: please keep a pinlist handy. we've seen a handful of mobile SDKs that don't set header consistently.
mira: copying the pin command here for operators:
```
# pin tenant to v1
deploybot pin --route split-route --tenant <tenant-id> --version v1 --reason "mobile-sdk-compat"
```
ash: can deploy-bot emit an automated canary metric snapshot when flip happens? need p50/p95 and 5xx counts.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: split-route flip -> v2 at 1749878343. Canary window: 10m. Will emit canary snapshot at +2m, +5m, +10m. :white_check_mark:
jamie: updated release notes snippet for the flip (short): "v2 routing enables structured streaming and header-based auth. Breaking change: clients without X-API-Version header will be routed to v1 until cutoff 2026-06-01."
oliver: flag: mobile proxies in APAC still rewrite headers occasionally — recommend we exclude region apac-1 for first stage.
mira: ack, will scope to us-west only for initial 30%.
ash: preflight: run the client compatibility probe against the last 7 days of logs to estimate how many requests lack X-API-Version.
jamie: ran probe — ~0.6% missing header globally, 1.8% on mobile. us-west estimated 0.9%. low but not zero.
mira: ops checklist: 1) pinlist open, 2) abort runbook ready, 3) rollback playbook confirmed, 4) slack channel + IR oncall.
nash: please link the rollback steps in-channel before flip.
jamie: rollback playbook: short form ->
```
1) deploybot rollback --route split-route --to-version v1
2) revoke temporary canary config: /infra/canary/split-route
3) unpin any tenants we auto-pinned during the flip (audit in /ops/pins)
4) notify clients + update release notes
```
jamie: also: auto-pin heuristic enabled: if a tenant gets >50% 5xx in 2m, deploy-bot will auto-pin them to v1. confirm that's toggled on?
deploy-bot: auto-pin heuristic is ENABLED (threshold=50% 5xx, window=120s). Will post per-tenant actions as they occur.
oliver: FYI we saw a weird route-drift last month where a canary proxy started dropping v2 cookies and produced 502s. ops should watch proxy 502 spike.
mira: set alert: proxy.502.count > 10 in 2m for split-route -> page oncall.
nash: agreed. also enable structured-logs flag for the flip so we can trace a sample path end-to-end.
jamie: ok flipping scope: us-west only, 30% traffic, no apac, no EU. timeline: +30m start, +40m evaluate, +60m further rollout if stable.
mira: oncall is stby. I'll post gate results at +12m and +40m.
(12m later)
mira: Gate check +12m: p50 +12ms (baseline +2ms), p95 +90ms (baseline +10ms), 5xx small uptick +2 -> currently 7 total in the canary window. No tenant exceeded auto-pin threshold. Recommend continue to +40m. :thumbsup:
nash: confirm continue. remind docs team to push the release note addendum about pinning instructions.
jamie: continuing. will update channel when we hit +40.
(40m later)
mira: Gate check +40m: p95 normalized, 5xx stable, one tenant (tenant-9342) saw 28% 5xx over 2m — deploy-bot auto-pinned them to v1 and notified.
deploy-bot: Action: auto-pin tenant-9342 -> pinned to v1 at 1749876795. Reason: sustained 5xx above threshold.
jamie: good catch. ops, did we see any proxy 502 spike?
oliver: no 502 spike. root cause for tenant-9342 looks like client behavior parsing v2 structured events incorrectly (missing closing JSON array).
mira: ops recommends to continue rollout, gradually increase to 60% in us-west in next window. docs: add tenant-9342 as example in troubleshooting.
nash: can we record this as a regression test? add a prompt-based eval to catch malformed structured events that used to be accepted by v1.
jamie: will create an eval ticket.
mira: final note: keeping the change window open for 2h in case of late effects. I'll mark this flip as "proceed with caution" in the release board. :white_check_mark:
jamie: thanks everyone. rolling forward and updating release notes with pin/rollback snippets and the tenant incident.
(1h later)
mira: postmortem-lite: one auto-pin; no rollback required. closing thread.
